subject.title: improve: show edit mismatch candidate lines

question: Should this PR's candidate-line wording and bounded diagnostic shape become the canonical implementation for the edit mismatch diagnostics request?
rationale: Several live PRs implement the same user-facing error-output contract, and automation should not choose the final wording and canonical branch alone.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: After required checks are clean, land this bounded implementation and close or rebase the sibling attempts against it.

options.title: Prefer a sibling PR
options.body: Pause this PR and choose another open implementation if its output contract is closer to the desired product behavior.

options.title: Request a combined branch
options.body: Ask for one final narrow PR that preserves the bounded scanner while adopting any preferred wording from sibling attempts.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
